name: coh-sidekick-pipeline
description: CoH Sidekick 1.0 data pipeline: converters, regen, gates, and contract/fixture emitters over the frozen TS oracle

scripts.build:web: rm -rf target/dx/Sidekick/release/web && cd crates/app && dx build --platform web --release --debug-symbols false --keep-names
scripts.audit:set-categories: for ds in $(node -p "require('./scripts/_dataset-paths.cjs').ALL_DATASETS.join(' ')"); do node scripts/audit-allowed-set-categories.cjs --dataset "$ds" --gate || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --no-deps -p coh_data -p coh_math -p coh_wasm -p app --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.fmt:rust: cargo fmt -p coh_data -p coh_math -p coh_wasm -p app
scripts.fmt:rust:check: cargo fmt -p coh_data -p coh_math -p coh_wasm -p app -- --check
scripts.baseline:write: node scripts/keys/prov8-shard-drift.cjs --gate && COH_WRITE_BASELINE=1 cargo test -p coh_math --test totals_baseline -- --nocapture
scripts.validate:converter: for ds in $(node -p "require('./scripts/_dataset-paths.cjs').ALL_DATASETS.join(' ')"); do node scripts/validate-converter-output.cjs --dataset "$ds" --gate || exit 1; done
scripts.validate:incarnate-collapse: for ds in $(node -p "require('./scripts/_dataset-paths.cjs').ALL_DATASETS.join(' ')"); do node scripts/dsh8-incarnate-collapse-detector.cjs --dataset "$ds" --gate || exit 1; done

author: Wednesdaywoe
